Barcelona will equal Real Madrid's record of eight European
titles if they win. The Spaniards will be playing in their 287th
European match, another record. They are also playing in a
record sixth Cup Winners' Cup final.
Paris St Germain this season equalled a record held jointly by
Real Madrid and Ajax Amsterdam of reaching the semifinals of a
European competition in five successive seasons.
The following seven clubs have reached the Cup Winners' Cup
final the season after winning the title. All ended as losers.
